full_prompt_en: A square narrative oil painting shows an older gray-bearded man crouched beside a weathered stone wall. His body faces left in profile, one knee raised and the other near the ground. He lifts a hand close to his mouth as if calling or listening, while his gaze travels toward the pale distance. Thick silver hair and a long white-gray beard catch the cool light along the face. He wears a faded brick-red jacket over layered gray clothing, heavy boots, and a rugged vest or pack crowded with straps and small pockets. A bulky dark backpack rests against the wall behind him. A rounded protective helmet lies on the ground near his lower right hand, its glass opening and dark interior catching a muted glint. The wall occupies the right half of the background, its rough beige surface marked by chips and stains. To the left, a hazy city of low blocklike buildings recedes under a blue-gray and salmon-colored sky. A dark airplane silhouette crosses the air high behind him. The distant city and aircraft are atmospheric rather than crisply detailed, while the foreground face, clothing, and equipment are worked with heavier texture. Diffuse cool light from the open left side strikes the hair, hand, and knees; warm rusty color in the jacket and sky adds contrast. The man is the principal mass, seated against the vertical wall, with his raised hand creating a small clear gesture within the rough scene. The image balances human vulnerability and endurance through restrained expression, weathered material, and the uneasy openness of the sky.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形叙事油画呈现一名灰须老人蜷蹲在风化石墙旁。身体侧向左，一条膝盖抬起，另一条靠近地面。他把一只手举到嘴边，似在呼喊或倾听，目光投向浅淡远处。浓密银发和长长的灰白胡须沿面孔接住冷光。他穿褪色砖红夹克，内搭层层灰色衣服，脚穿厚靴，身上是挤满背带和小口袋的粗犷背心或背包。一个厚重的深色背包靠在身后墙上。圆形防护头盔放在右手下方的地上，玻璃开口和暗内部有一点微弱反光。墙占据背景右半部，粗糙米色表面带崩痕和污迹。左侧，一片低矮方块房屋组成的朦胧城市退入蓝灰与鲑粉色天空下。深色飞机剪影从人物后上方天空穿过。远城与飞机更偏空气感，而前景面孔、衣着和装备使用厚重纹理。来自左侧开阔空间的漫射冷光照到头发、手和膝盖；夹克与天空中的暖锈色形成对照。男子是主要形体，倚坐在垂直墙面前，举起的手在粗糙场景里形成一个清楚的小动作。画面通过克制表情、磨损材料和天空令人不安的开阔感，平衡人的脆弱与坚韧。
style_prompt_en: Narrative oil painting uses textured brushwork and weathered surfaces to build a grounded, cinematic scene. A cool blue-gray atmospheric distance contrasts with near warm rust, muted flesh, and beige stone. Foreground fabric, hair, straps, and chipped masonry receive concrete detail; distant forms soften into haze. Open sky gives diffuse side light with restrained highlights on edges and no glossy polish. A strong vertical plane can shelter a compact crouched form, while a small gesture becomes the emotional center. The palette is dusty and subdued, and the visible strokes preserve a sense of physical wear.
style_prompt_zh: 叙事油画以有纹理的笔触和磨旧表面建立有重量的电影感场景。冷蓝灰的空气远景对照近处暖锈色、低饱和肤色与米色石面。前景布料、发丝、背带和缺角墙体获得具体细节；远处形状在雾气里柔化。开阔天空提供漫射侧光，边缘有克制高光，没有光滑亮漆感。坚实竖向平面可庇护紧凑蜷蹲形体，一个小手势成为情绪中心。色彩蒙尘且低调，可见笔触保留物质磨损感。
theme_en: A gray-bearded man in worn red outerwear kneeling against a damaged wall
theme_zh: 一名灰须男子穿磨旧红外衣，跪靠破损墙面
name: Jon McNaughton
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
